risk_if_not_implemented: Without Masking Displayed Sensitive / Regulated Data, inaccurate, stale, corrupted or manipulated data may drive flawed decisions and control failures. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical Access Control
compensating_control_1.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to enforce physical access authorizations for all physical access points (including designated entry/exit points) to facilities (excluding those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical Access Control (PES-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Masking Displayed Data (DCH-12) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_2.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Masking Displayed Data (DCH-12) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
